title: lolium × elongatum
intro: Lolium × elongatum, commonly known as meadow fescue, is a hybrid grass species that belongs to the family Poaceae. The health benefits of meadow fescue include its potential to support digestive health and reduce inflammation due to its prebiotic properties. The therapeutic actions of meadow fescue include its ability to promote wound healing and exhibit antimicrobial properties, likely due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. However, further research is needed to fully understand the properties and effects of meadow fescue, but it is known to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
